tips.text: Check the bounty's reward list before you queue; if Verdilac is not on it, the board is on Rotation B or C.
Keep running bounties on Rotation B and C too; they still drop the 12 Narmer Isoplast the build needs.
Farm Caliban, Korumm, Nepheri and the Archon mods in the same bounties; they all pay from these runs and need Isoplast.
Run public squads and finish every bonus objective; the bonus roll is the only lever you have on the stage 5 table.
Bring Volt or another fast frame to keep a full bounty near 7 to 8 minutes.
Take the bounty from whichever hub is faster for you; Cetus and Fortuna share one drop table.
Once the drop shows on your screen, leave the landscape cleanly; host migration after extraction can wipe a finished bounty's reward.
Grind Mortus Horn and Star Amarast on the side instead of waiting on the blueprint to drop.
Players complain about stingy Isoplast and no pity system, but 12 Isoplast is only a few bounties.
